notes: Squeek (SQK) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 SQK once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. Transfers deliver the full amount without taxes or fees. The token has no administrative powers or further minting, and there are no application contracts or initialization calls. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
